about: Inquiry-triage eval cases. Seeds are real inquiries Elle Jones received, anonymized (names, phones, emails, and neighborhoods changed; wording kept). Variations were written from the seeds. Expected answers were proposed by Claude and reviewed by Elle. The mix reflects Elle's studio-based business: mostly studio sessions, events only occasionally. All cases use today = 2026-09-24. A location of "any" means any answer is accepted (e.g. the client only says "your studio"). Added for triage v1 (2026-09-25): photographer.profile mirrors Elle’s studio profile and booking setup, and expected.route says whether the reply should send the client to the booking page ("book"), offer a quote without the booking link ("quote"), or either (null). Added for triage v3 (2026-09-25): profile.faqs are Elle’s real FAQ answers (lightly edited), the booking-page sessions carry her real descriptions, and expected.needsYou is whether the photographer should handle the inquiry personally (null = either).

bookableSessions.name: Maternity
bookableSessions.description: 1 subject (significant other and the baby’s siblings included), up to 3 outfits, 20 edited photos with professional retouching, 1 11x17 glossy print. Additional edits and prints available to purchase.

bookableSessions.name: Senior Photos
bookableSessions.description: 1 person, up to 2 outfits, 15 edited photos with professional retouching, 1 outdoor or studio location, 1 free 11x17 glossy print. Additional edits and prints available to purchase.

bookableSessions.name: Boudoir Mini Session
bookableSessions.description: Relaxed, tasteful, guided session; no modeling experience needed. 8 edited photos with professional retouching, a free 11x17 glossy print, and an online gallery for viewing and ordering.

faqs.question: Do you offer payment plans?
faqs.answer:
Yes! You can pay over time through PayPal or Stripe with these options:
• Affirm: purchases from $35 to $30,000
• Cash App Afterpay: purchases from $1 to $4,000
• Klarna: buy now, pay later up to $10,000
• PayPal Pay Later: Pay in 4, or longer-term Pay Monthly

faqs.question: How much is the deposit, and is it refundable?
faqs.answer: The deposit is 50% of your session total. It's non-refundable, but if you cancel more than 72 hours before your session, it becomes a credit you can use toward a future session.

faqs.question: What if I need to reschedule or cancel?
faqs.answer:
Just send me a message to reschedule or cancel.

Rescheduling: You can reschedule once at no charge if you let me know at least 48 hours before your session. Each reschedule after that may have a $25 administrative fee.

Cancelling: If you cancel more than 72 hours before your session, you'll receive a session credit equal to your deposit to use toward a future session. Cancellations within 72 hours of the session are non-refundable and non-transferable.

If I ever have to cancel, you'll get a full refund of everything you've paid, or you can reschedule at no extra cost.

faqs.question: How long until I get my photos?
faqs.answer: Edited photos are usually ready in 5–7 days. During busy times it can take up to 2 weeks.

faqs.question: How many photos will I get?
faqs.answer: It depends on the session you choose. Each session on the booking page lists how many edited photos are included, and additional edits are available to purchase.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Wear whatever makes you feel like you! Vibrant colors show up beautifully in photos. Just make sure your clothes are free of wrinkles and lint.

faqs.question: Do you have outfits or a client wardrobe I can use?
faqs.answer: I don't have a client wardrobe, but I do have a few items you're welcome to use, like a graduation cap and gown, and small props such as a tiara and faux flowers.

faqs.question: Where is your studio, and is there parking?
faqs.answer: My studio is in my home in SW Gresham, OR. There's street parking right out front.

faqs.question: Do you travel for sessions? Is there a travel fee?
faqs.answer: I decide on travel case by case. Sessions outside the Portland, OR / Vancouver, WA area have an additional travel fee.

faqs.question: What happens if the weather is bad for an outdoor session?
faqs.answer: We have options! We can find a creative covered spot (like under a freeway overpass), move the session into the studio, or reschedule.

faqs.question: Can I bring my kids, partner, or pets?
faqs.answer: You're welcome to bring one support person. Please don't bring children or pets unless they're part of the shoot and we've talked about it beforehand.

faqs.question: Do you offer prints, albums, or wall art?
faqs.answer: Yes! I print on beautiful, high-quality glossy photo paper, up to 24 inches wide and as long as you like. Popular sizes are 5x7, 8x10, 11x17, and 13x19. I also offer photo books and posters at an additional cost.

faqs.question: Do you offer gift cards?
faqs.answer: Yes! I offer custom-designed gift cards. Give the gift of creative photography!

faqs.question: How many outfits can I bring?
faqs.answer: Each session lists how many outfits (looks) are included. Additional outfit changes are $15 each.
